reviewedBy: Claude (Opus 5), session 57b768fe, reading the /collect draft output with Jacob Kennedy
review: THE DRAFT'S 21-TYPE INCLUDE LIST WOULD HAVE COST 31 PRODUCTS. 31 of 150 are untyped, and an include list can only name types, so a non-empty one drops every one of them. At 21% untyped the generator sat just under its 25% threshold and proposed a list; the threshold is a heuristic and this is the case where reading it beats trusting it.

Empty include instead, so all 150 are carried. The one thing that needed dropping, a Gift Card, is refused by _scene.js on its own, which is exactly why the empty list is safe here: the classifier is already doing the excluding.
Every type lands in arcade, which is the cleanest single-room fit of the thirteen shops read today. Two Stern Pinball rows go to tabletop and five Parts rows scatter; both are fine.
$75 to $18,900, mean $5,463. This merchant will dominate a price-sorted Arcade shelf and it should: they sell actual cabinets.
